checks.model: passed — independently converted spherical masses, strict aperture boundary, no-agitation control, count/mass closure including transit, monotonic collection and supported transfer endpoints; eight model/record tests
checks.twoD: passed — shaking sieve, moving specimens, collector, three mass locations and equal-scale size inspection with equality/larger/smaller explanations
checks.threeD: passed — actual perforated plate, diameter-scaled spheres, supported source positions, alignment and slow transfer, collector, group highlights, orbit and zoom
checks.responsive: passed — both views at 390×844, 820×1180, 1280×960, 1920×1080; portrait/landscape theatre, exact SVG/canvas stage fit, no document overflow and dark theme
checks.practicalRecord: passed — eight trials cover 3/5/8 mm, initial and completed runs, intermediate transfers, 2 mm no-pass boundary, zero agitation and slower agitation; counts, worked unit conversions and notes exported; reload persistence
checks.playback: live 110-second guide completed; live manual 12-second run, pause/resume/replay/seek and Escape checked
checks.recordingGate: passed — live guide and manual run lock recording; paused states can be recorded, including an explicit separate transit mass
checks.cleanLoad: fresh-load inspection and time changes in 3D produced no warnings or errors

reviewScope: Internal engineering and model-consistency review; no independent expert, official board or physical-device certification.
